label: info
name: Andrea Fanelli
intro: I grew up in Rome, surrounded by beauty: becoming a designer felt inevitable. I'm an optimistic human being with a background in product and strategic design. I believe that with curiosity, intuition and imagination can take you anywhere, that's how I discover most of my ideas. I design meaningful experiences at the edges of perception, color, light and space. Through my work, I connect the past with the future, creating timeless works with a contemporary voice.
tagline: I believe great design is about creating a feeling. A powerful tool for communicating and shaping ideas. Not just a way to create objects but relationships that connect things, environments and people.

philosophy.title: Philosophy
points: I rely on authenticity, intuition and transparency to shape my ideas.
I create objects that carry emotions and design experiences that engage all the senses.

I embrace a multidisciplinary approach to connect the dots and move beyond categories. Having an idea and expressing it through any medium is key. Each medium offers a unique perspective, which allows me to approach problems from different angles.
I believe that taste is the one fundamental skill for the future and the process is what gives value to the product.
Story is the strategy. Every moment is an opportunity to create a connection and tell a story.
